raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "localTimeToUtc now resolves the offset at the candidate instant and refines it once, instead of using one offset taken at the start of the UTC date. I traced Berlin and New York on all four clock-change days, plus Auckland and an early-morning Berlin time. Each gives the correct UTC instant, so the first slot is at opening and the last ends at closing. I could not see slotsForDay, so a day whose opening hours span the clock change itself is unchecked."}
